universal_reasoning.argument: For 0<=j<f, K'=fK and rho'=jK+rho give 0<=rho'<K'. Rank admission becomes m+e<=mf+e<=d. n'=0 gives compact=0, rest=H, before=u-2H, after=z-u-mfK, suffix=a-z. All are admitted by parent inequalities. All 19 retained fields are unchanged. Eight fields are parsed but not semantically used by this exact consumer; the private view must not be passed to generic producer/ordinary interfaces.

One-column widths sum to z; the coefficient suffix is a-z. Thus 2^z*(2hr*2^(a-z))=2^a*2hr for every complete row. Chosen positions equal u+(if+j)K+rho. Columns have disjoint coordinate factors, so their full monomial maps commute and multiply to the parent tensor map, including one constant phase per column. Inverses commute likewise.

The unchanged engine computes n=f'-1=0, hence every affine gate enters single_column_rows. It invokes flip_digit/digit_permutation and cannot call compact_gate, the route into PairDispatch/ordinary. Ordinary construction and its fixed port inventory still exist and must remain charged.

PREPARE increments an encoded counter from 0 to f while adding K, then resets column to zero. Every NEXT follows a completed native call, increments column once, and either emits rho+jK or finishes exactly at f. All scans are over admitted finite prefixes; all current private prefixes are erased and heads restored by RELEASE. Parent/markers are never written. Arbitrary malformed origin markers are outside this cleanup theorem.

A phase i^p acts by a signed pair permutation: p=1 requires imaginary != most-negative; p=2 requires both != most-negative; p=3 requires real != most-negative; p=0 has no negation restriction. Strict symmetric component headroom is invariant. The constant-2/f=2 and constant-1/f=4 examples have representable batched endpoints but unrepresentable intermediate serial phases. Later rejection can leave earlier columns committed, so no whole-job rollback follows.

The inherited one-column source bill is charged f times, including full-field import/export, protected copies, affine gates, signed scans, encoded setup, cohort marker initialization, retirement, and every fixed Q role including unused ordinary ports. Metadata O(f(E+1)) is absorbed by displayed f(E+1)^4. Count multiplication scans binary digits, so zero times large G is polynomial in descriptor length. power_two loops at most a, bounded by E from row_bits=record_bits*2^a; signed-format counting uses amortized ripple counters. This validates the repeated bill relative to the cited inherited native cost theorem.

Both the 45 descriptor roles and all native roles retain historical maximum physical backing. Current-prefix retirement does not free old cells. A later small call can stop at a fresh blank current frontier without scanning erased older allocation, which remains in space. O(fV) requires both explicit R1>=A1^6 and (E+1)^4+Q=O(V); these do not follow for arbitrary admitted geometry.
